_about: THE store listing words (T1072), one source for Google Play, the App Store and the website. Read by deploy/staging/play-listing-push.py (Play text, App Store plan via --appstore), app/tools/web-shell.mjs (home page meta description) and checked by app/tools/store-listing.test.ts (every limit and forbidden word). Words are the owner's; edit them here only. Facts (not words) stay in handoff/PLAN/play/listing.md. (T1134) creativeAssetLine is the one line under the name on the App Store creative assets (the Header and Search Results pictures and videos, tools/store-shots/creative.mjs); owner 2026-11-25: "say rules and conditions by the water". It is the subtitle with "and conditions" added: the subtitle itself is at its 30-character limit and cannot grow. Picture words only: it is sent to no store field.
